name: Mysore Bonda
steps: Whisk yogurt smooth. Stir in both flours, coconut, chilli, ginger, cumin and salt to make a thick batter.
Add just enough water to let the batter fall slowly from a spoon. Beat well to incorporate air; rest briefly.
Fold in baking soda just before frying. Heat oil to medium; a small drop of batter should rise steadily, not darken at once.
Drop rounded spoonfuls into oil, leaving space for them to puff. Turn gently and fry until evenly golden and cooked in the centre.
Drain and serve hot with coconut chutney; the inside should be light and spongy.
tips: This instant bonda uses soda for lift; unlike goli baje, the batter does not need long fermentation.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
